content.rendered:
BBTECH is  providing outsourced IT services to businesses in UAE The benefit we bring to you and your business is to have all of your IT services managed from one place, with one point of contact, just like your very own IT department but without all the costs. We will align all your domains, hosting, connectivity and support in one place. Our IT contracts and service level agreements (SLA) can also cover your hardware warranties and software developments.

For Tech & Support, you can get in Touch for your Inquiries

  • Phone number
    +971 54 405 6829
  • Email
    info@bbtech.ae
  • Address
    Po Box. 202135, Al Ain , United Arab Emirates
